nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real Banach space, let $X \subseteq E$ be an open convex set, and let $f \colon E \to \mathbb{R}$ be twice continuously differentiable on $X$. Then $f$ is convex on $X$ if and only if $f(x) \ge f(a) + Df(a)(x - a)$ for all $a, x \in X$, where $Df(a)$ is the Fréchet derivative of $f$ at $a$ within $X$.
